name: Opium
indications_original: Opium tincture is useful for the treatment of diarrhea.
contraindications_original: Usual Adult Dose – 0.6 mL orally 4 times a day.
adverseReactions_original: This preparation is not recommended for use in children. It should not be used in diarrhea caused by poisoning until the toxic material is eliminated from the gastrointestinal tract.
